arbiter: Hand-derived integer-label membership in inclusive conjunction orbs; no sky values.
equations: Moving Moon = 50+t, Venus = 55+t degrees modulo 360. Fixed natal Sun = 60, Jupiter = 65. Inclusive orb = 5 degrees. All labels are invented milliseconds and coordinates; speeds are irrelevant.

cases.derivation: Union of the four pair sets.
Intersection of every pair, including both inclusive endpoints at t=10.

zeroOrb.derivation: A contact is an eligible singleton integer label, independent of applying or separating motion.

uncertain.derivation: Expand each canned root bracket to [root-1,root+1] inclusive, clip, then subtract from the any-pair set.
